thread:
marta: Quick sync — security wants a coordinated base-image rebuild for runtime hardening. Goals: remove setuid bits, add seccomp profiles, ensure SBOM + cosign attestations, and tighten KMS/RBAC so image-builder SA only has minimal signing rights. Who can own canary + rollout?
kevin: I can lead the canary and the repo changes. Two quick Qs: do we reuse the existing `image-signing` KMS key or create a new envelope key per environment? Also timeline constraints?
lina: New key per environment please — keeps blast radius smaller and satisfies compliance. Also we need the cosign signature thumbprint surfaced in audit events and shipped to images.audit in Splunk. retention: 13 months. :eyes:
jen: Heads up — avoid full rollout during next infra maintenance window (Mon 14:00-18:00 PST). SRE asks we validate that node bootstrapping still works if seccomp is enabled; some older init containers may fail. Canary plan: 5% staging -> 25% staging -> prod canary.
marta: Agreed. RBAC notes: image-builder SA should only get storage read for the bucket and the KMS signer role scoped to `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/signing`. I'll open an IAM ticket. Example grant command for the IAM ticket:
```
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-prod \
  --member=serviceAccount:image-builder@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.signer \
  --condition='expression=request.resource.name.startsWith("projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/image/")'
```
kevin: Thanks. On build infra — we need SBOMs baked with Syft and attached as artifact metadata, and then cosign attestation. I'll add a packer step to emit `sbom.json` and wire the pipeline to `cosign sign --attestation sbom.json`.
paul: (secops-bot) Quick scan on current base image before rebuild: found high CVEs in glibc, libcurl, openssl — triage ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-4201. Patch first, then rebuild.
marta: Good catch. Kevin — do we have capacity to patch and re-run the full image test matrix this week? Also we need to confirm that attestation metadata schema v2 is compatible with existing ingestion.
kevin: I can do the patches and run tests for amd64/gpu variants. ETA: end of day Thu. For ingestion, Lina — can you confirm the required JSON fields we need in the audit event?
lina: We'll need these fields: `artifact_name`, `digest`, `cosign_signature`, `sbom_ref`, `kms_key_id`, `signer_principal`. Also add `canary_percent` and `pipeline_run_id` for tracing. I'll drop a sample schema in the ticket.
jen: Add an automated rollback hook in the rollout job: if `error_rate > 1%` or `avg_p90_latency regressed > 200ms` for 10m, rollback to previous image. Also capture `kubectl describe pod` logs into the audit event on failure.
marta: Ops checklist and owners:
- kevin -> patch + packer changes + canary run
- lina -> audit schema + Splunk pipeline + KMS key provisioning
- jen -> rollout job + rollback hooks + SRE validation
- marta -> open IAM ticket + coordinate compliance signoff
I'll create the umbrella ticket `SEC-4202` to track. Meeting? 30m sync tomorrow 10am to unblock keys and RBAC.
deploy-bot: Pipeline triggered: `base-image-rebuild/v2` by kevin/patch-glibc (#1732). Logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/blue/organizations/jenkins/base-image-rebuild/activity
marta: Perfect. If anyone spots blockers reply here or tag me in the ticket. :thumbsup:
